stemMd: A pipe fills an empty tank in 6 hours while a leak alone would empty a full tank in 15 hours. With both operating at constant rates, how long does filling take?
explanationMd: Net filling rate is 1/6−1/15=1/10 tank per hour. Its reciprocal is 10 hours. The time must exceed 6 because the leak opposes filling.

distractorRationale.c: Subtracting the separate times does not combine rates.
distractorRationale.e: This adds the draining rate instead of subtracting it.
distractorRationale.a: Adding completion times does not combine rates.
